answers.reason: The senate is a central body and the dean does not hold an office specified for senate membership.
Budget planning touches university-wide plans and higher office holders are involved, but the dean leads a single faculty rather than holding a university-wide office.
Appointment committees select candidates for professorships, which are faculty matters where the dean as leader of the faculty is involved.
The dean leads the faculty and chairs its council.
The study commission prepares degree programme changes for the faculty, falling under the dean's leadership of the faculty.
Examination boards decide faculty examination matters, where the dean holds responsibility as head of the faculty.
Internal research funding awards faculty grants, involving the faculty leadership.
Module revision affects study programmes of the faculty, which fall under the faculty leadership.
Laboratory equipment procurement is a faculty-level matter falling under the faculty leadership.
Orientation week planning is a student and faculty matter where the dean holds overall responsibility for the faculty.
